title: JANUS Linear A v0.8 Implementation B: higher-order typed neighborhoods with triple-null max-T

implementation_A_context.rule: Implementation B must not privilege the v0.8-A GRA -> 10PLUS -> *304 screen signal. It may rediscover it only if the frozen B hypothesis family and nulls independently select it.

representation_precondition.rule: Known controls remain as non-endpoint MASK/K slots; they are never deleted from row geometry and never used as nominally new endpoints.

partition_protocol.HT_SCREEN: deterministic document-hash partition, candidate discovery only
partition_protocol.HT_CONFIRM: disjoint deterministic HT partition, locked candidate confirmation only
partition_protocol.NON_HT: all non-HT documents, cross-region replication only after HT_CONFIRM

predeclared_hypothesis_families.definition: T_left -> T_middle -> T_right; the blind middle-token identity defines a context class and the tested directed edge is left -> right conditional on that middle context.
T_left -> numeric_bucket -> T_right with exact buckets FRAC/ONE/2_4/5_9/10PLUS and UNCERTAIN kept distinct.
First two row slots must both be eligible semantic candidates; MASK/numeric slots prevent the hypothesis rather than being deleted.
Last two row slots must both be eligible semantic candidates; MASK/numeric slots prevent the hypothesis rather than being deleted.
Candidate-level concentration of semantic predecessor identities among direct within-row TT adjacency events.
Candidate-level concentration of semantic successor identities among direct within-row TT adjacency events.

numeric_buckets.UNCERTAIN: typed numeric-like marker without licensed exact scalar

destructive_nulls.destroys: candidate-specific row-local identity coupling while retaining document composition
specific endpoint coupling within TTT-middle, numeric-bucket, row-boundary, and direct-TT adjacency classes

statistic.specialization_hypotheses: Herfindahl concentration sum((neighbor_count/total_neighbor_events)^2) for incoming or outgoing semantic neighbors
statistic.family_scope: pair hypotheses and candidate specialization hypotheses are included in the same stage-level max-T family for each destructive null

HT_SCREEN.rule: A hypothesis locks only if it meets support minima, has positive enrichment/specialization, and max-T FWER p <= 0.05 under every one of the three destructive nulls.

HT_CONFIRM.rule: Locked screen hypotheses are tested only in the disjoint HT_CONFIRM partition. Family-wise max-T across the locked set is required independently under all three nulls. Non-evaluable support is recorded separately from statistical failure.

NON_HT.rule: Only HT-confirmed hypotheses reach non-HT. Locked one-sided p-values are Bonferroni-corrected over confirmed hypotheses x three null families; all three corrected p-values must pass plus support/region minima.

anti_p_hacking_constraints: do not lower v0.7/v0.8-A support minima because earlier results were negative
do not change numeric bucket boundaries after seeing outcomes
do not privilege or force-test the v0.8-A GRA -> 10PLUS -> *304 screen signal
do not remove MASK/K positions and create synthetic adjacency
do not call same-corpus A/B agreement external replication
do not advance a non-evaluable candidate as a failed or successful replication
